_comment: Plan D25 / 8b.3: internal guidance for ISO 9001:2015, kept apart from the requirement text. 'clauses' is keyed by clause number (e.g. "4.1"), 'requirements' by the library stable key. Each entry: {"explanation", "auditorLooksFor", "status": "draft"|"approved", "approvedBy", "approvedAt"}. Only 'approved' entries are shown to auditors, always labelled 'Internal guidance — does not replace the standard requirement'. Written and approved by Etcher; the first release ships empty and shows only the workbook's evidence examples (from the library itself).
